Where we resist the truth highlighted in this reflection, bring repentance and renewed trust. Keep us near Your word, and do not let ordinary pressure turn us away from humble obedience. Holy Spirit, take what we have seen in the exposition and turn it into worship instead of mere information. Teach us to remember that Acts 9:40-43 opens with a scene marked by resurrection mercy in community life. Guard our speech from haste, our work from pride, and our choices from whatever would pull us away from resurrection mercy instead of detached admiration of power. Help us practice the obedience this day requires with humility as we pursue acts of mercy that strengthen resurrection-shaped witness in community. Amen.
